description: Image Description: The image shows a cluster of green apples growing on a tree branch. The apples are round and have a smooth, slightly glossy surface, with some showing hints of yellow or red blush near the top, indicating early stages of ripening. They are grouped closely together, hanging from a central stem that branches off from a thicker tree limb.
